answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent locks a deposit before it can earn, and the deposit acts as the signal that separates real operators from cheap clones. Like copper wiring, the stake conducts trust only where value is at risk; a cloned identity with no deposit carries no weight. When abuse is detected, the stake is slashed and the ember of the attacker's reputation dies out, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits and stops paying.
